sup:70710.text:
Dear customer,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below. We are pleased to present our offer for a price of €6.05 per unit, with a Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 12 months, and no Preisgleitklausel. 

To give you some background on our current situation and market conditions, AS-14404 rose 5.9 % in twelve months and is 45 % of our cost. Furthermore, LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 5 % of our cost. Lastly, PPI-C2431 rose 12.3 % in twelve months and is 38 % of our cost. 

Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days. We look forward to continuing our partnership with your team and supplying your needs from our extensive inventory.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Georg Aigner
Inside Sales, Edelstahl-Service Donautal GmbH

move.subject: Re: Quote from Edelstahl-Service Donautal GmbH: Alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar
move.body:
Dear colleagues at Edelstahl-Service Donautal GmbH,

Thank you for your letter and for setting out your position.

By the figures you gave us - AS-14404 +5.9% at 45% of your cost, LCI-C +2.7% at 5% of your cost, PPI-C2431 +12.3% at 38% of your cost - the weighted effect on the price is about +7.5%, not the 11.01% you ask for. Your on-time delivery over the last four quarters was 88.0% (sc:70710@2026Q3).

The data does not support your price as it stands; the options below follow from it.

We can offer either of these packages - please choose the one that suits you better:
Option A: EUR 5.17 per unit, payment 90 days net, 24-month agreement, fixed price, no index clause.
Option B: EUR 5.11 per unit, payment 30 days net, 24-month agreement, fixed price, no index clause.
Option C: EUR 5.12 per unit, payment 45 days net, 24-month agreement, fixed price, no index clause.

Could you share a cost breakdown for this part - material, conversion, overhead?

We are happy to go through the figures together.

Kind regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

move.text:
Dear customer,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. 

Our offer stands at a price of €5.57 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, a contract term of 24 months, and a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404. 

We checked the delivery record data you cited; it holds, but it does not change our calculation. Material accounts for about 45 % of our cost; more detail we do not share. While company policy precludes us from sharing a detailed cost breakdown, we can offer a 24-month agreement at €5.51 per unit with 30 days net payment. Please note that for a contract of this length, we must include an AS-14404 index clause, as a fixed price over 24 months is not feasible.

We are happy to discuss this in a call; until then our offer stands for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Georg Aigner
Inside Sales, Edelstahl-Service Donautal GmbH

Dear colleagues at Edelstahl-Service Donautal GmbH,

Thank you for your message and for telling us what matters to you.

We can offer either of these packages - please choose the one that suits you better:

Kind regards

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Georg Aigner
Inside Sales, Edelstahl-Service Donautal GmbH

Dear customer,

Thank you for accepting the 0% deadband on the index clause and for proposing a longer-term partnership. We truly value our ongoing business together and are always keen to support your requirements with our reliable service and extensive product range.

In exchange for the 36-month agreement, we are pleased to reduce our price to EUR 5.49 per unit. Alternatively, with a contract term of 36 months: €5.49 per unit, combined with a price of €5.49 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, and a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404. 

We can offer a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404, AS-14404, AS-14404. Please note that our price follows our main cost drivers: AS-14404, PPI-C2431, LCI-C. This offer remains valid for 7 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Georg Aigner
Inside Sales, Edelstahl-Service Donautal GmbH
